messages:
Rae (People Ops): hey all — heads up: Anika submitted resignation, relocating to Berlin. last day 2024-12-15. wants help with final payroll, COBRA, shipping laptop internationally, and transferring admin access for internal docs.

Anika (Eng): thanks. quick asks: 1) need prepaid shipping + customs letter for laptop + dock. 2) will exercise vested options — want to know payroll timing. 3) can slack remain active 48h for message export and calendar forwarding to manager for 60 days?

Rae (People Ops): noted. Benefits & Payroll, can you confirm COBRA and payroll timeline? IT-Bot for international shipping. Security for token rotations/admin handoff.

Benefits (HR): condolence & noted. employer medical coverage runs through 12/31 if termination 12/15 (end of month rule). COBRA packet emailed within ~7 business days; 60 day election window.

Payroll (Finance): final pay + accrued PTO paid on next payroll run: 2024-12-30. if you exercise options to include in payroll, notify before 2024-12-10 to sync withholding.

IT-Bot: auto: intl-return ticket created. please confirm destination and preferred courier. will provide company letter for customs and pre-paid DHL label if approved.

Anika (Eng): courier DHL to Germany, please include charger. serials in handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.com/handoffs/anika-exit.

Security (SRE): we will rotate org tokens and remove admin rights after 48h post-last-day. add two owners for any org-level services before exit. sample deprov cmd: ./deprov --user anika --slack-delay 48h --rotate-keys

Anika (Eng): added Lina & Omar as co-owners on Confluence and Trello. requested 48h slack grace + auto-reply to manager.

Rae (People Ops): i'll send exit packet now with asset label, payroll dates, COBRA note, and exit interview link. please submit any expenses by 2024-12-12.

IT-Bot: label emailed to anika.personal@example.com tracking: DH987654321DE.

Payroll (Finance): record: final pay scheduled 2024-12-30.

Rae (People Ops): closing loop — Jira HR-1991 updated with handoff doc, tracking, and benefits notes. DM if anything else.
